images.filename: Moelders (D186) USS Iowa (BB-61) 1985.jpeg
images.caption: The West German guided missile destroyer Mölders (D 186), foreground, and the U.S. battleship USS Iowa (BB-61) underway during the NATO Exercise "BALTOPS '85" in the Baltic Sea, on 1 October 1985.
images.alt: The West German guided missile destroyer Mölders (D 186), foreground, and the U.S. battleship USS Iowa (BB-61) underway during the NATO Exercise "BALTOPS '85" in the Baltic Sea, on 1 October 1985.
images.artist: Photographer's Name: JOCS Russ Egnor, USNR-R

images.filename: Rommel D187 Mölders D186 Kiel 1985.jpeg
images.caption: U.S. Navy crew members stand ready on the bow of the guided missile frigate USS Halyburton (FFG-40) as the ship pulls into the port of Kiel, Schleswig-Holstein (Germany), for a visit during the NATO exercise "BALTOPS '85", on 1 October 1985. In the background are the West German destroyers Rommel (D 187), Mölders (D 186), and the fast patrol craft tender Elbe (A 61).
images.alt: U.S. Navy crew members stand ready on the bow of the guided missile frigate USS Halyburton (FFG-40) as the ship pulls into the port of Kiel, Schleswig-Holstein (Germany), for a visit during the NATO exercise "BALTOPS '85", on 1 October 1985. In the background are the West German destroyers Rommel (D 187), Mölders (D 186), and the fast patrol craft tender Elbe (A 61).
images.artist: Photographer's Name: JOCS Russ Egnor, USNR-R

images.filename: USS OH Perry (FFG-7) Luetjens (D185) 1994.jpeg
images.caption: View of several ships in port during the exercise "Baltic Operation '942 (BALTOPS 94), on 7 June 1994. The ships were the guided missile frigate USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), the Russian guided missile frigate Neustrashimyy (left), and the German destroyers Lütjens (D 185) and Mölders (D 186) (right).
images.alt: View of several ships in port during the exercise "Baltic Operation '942 (BALTOPS 94), on 7 June 1994. The ships were the guided missile frigate USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), the Russian guided missile frigate Neustrashimyy (left), and the German destroyers Lütjens (D 185) and Mölders (D 186) (right).
images.artist: Photographer's Name: JOC Michael Gallagher, USN

images.filename: German destroyer Mölders (D186) off Maine in 1969.jpg
images.caption: The West German Navy guided missile destroyer Mölders (D 186) underway off Bath, Maine (USA), on sea trials in 1969. While under construction, this ship was assigned the U.S. Navy hull number "DDG-29". Mölders was commissioned on 20 September 1969.
